description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`) for a refusal's phrases, played apart from the cases. `an-orientation-in-a-second-sheet-of-the-themes-folder.json` is refused by `evidence` for an orientation query in `print.css`, and here its `says` keeps that phrase and gains the one `an-orientation-query-in-the-theme.json` holds for `pct.css` — the drift a pinned phrase exists to catch — once after its own phrase and once before it. The runner has to report each, and nothing of the case pinned to its own phrase alone.
